name: TRMNL X
description: TRMNL X, 10.3 inch monochrome ePaper at 1872x1404. Stock firmware speaks TRMNL BYOS; reports its model as `x` on the /api/setup handshake.
notes_md: Confirmed on real hardware running the stock TRMNL firmware. It auto-provisions on first poll; Tesserae picks the native 1872x1404 panel from the Model header. Point the device's API URL at your Tesserae base URL and pair via the access token shown in Settings -> Devices.
